content: We need to determine number of unique carbon environments in a given compound. But we have no structure provided in text. Possibly the compound is shown in an image? Not provided. We may need to get 13C NMR spectra via tool carbon_nmr_spectra which returns spectra as string, which likely includes chemical shift peaks. From that we can count distinct signals, which correspond to unique carbon environments (assuming no overlapping). So we should call carbon_nmr_spectra.
